Subject: Your Sigma 18-35 rental deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thank you for renting the Sigma 18-35 from us. I'm sorry to be writing with news you probably didn't want. When the lens came back, the front element was scratched, and we kept $160 of your $600 deposit to cover it.

I know that's frustrating, especially when you expected the full deposit back. We believe the charge is fair, since a scratch on the front element is damage beyond normal wear and tear. I can send you photos of the scratch if you'd like to see it.

We'd also like to meet you partway. If you prefer, we can lower the charge to $100 and refund the $60 difference.

How would you like to proceed? Let me know whether you'd like the photos, the reduced charge, or something else.

Best regards,
[Your name]
